You are a hosted-E2E operator on freytag-forge. Working directory: the real repository /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge. This task runs WITHOUT a sandbox and spends real money (Cloudflare neurons).

HARD RULES. Change nothing except artifacts/e2e-* and frontend/test-results/ (generated, gitignored) and bench/results/stage3-alias/attempt-1/ . No tracked-file edits; no git add/commit/checkout/stash/reset/clean/push. Never print, echo, copy or upload .env or any token; `source .env` only inside the commands below. Staging only: stop if the API channel is not 'staging'. Run `@alias-smoke` AT MOST ONCE - never retry a failed run, because every attempt counts. Nothing else billed. Do not edit code to make a run pass.

WHAT THIS IS: attempt 1 of 3 in the linked hosted 1A-to-1B photo-word smoke (frontend/e2e/scene-runtime.spec.js, test tagged @alias-smoke): ordinary photo words in 1A, then the photograph in 1B, one session. Stopping rule fixed in advance: exactly 3 attempts, failures counted, no replacements.

STEPS:
1. `mkdir -p bench/results/stage3-alias/attempt-1 && source .env && curl -s "$E2E_API_BASE_URL/api/v1/version" > bench/results/stage3-alias/attempt-1/identity.json` (required channel staging, runtime scene-v1; the check enforces it).
2. (first attempt: no series gate.)
3. `rm -f artifacts/e2e-alias-smoke.json artifacts/e2e-alias-smoke.md`
4. `source .env && cd frontend && E2E_TURN_TIMEOUT_MS=90000 npm run test:e2e -- --grep @alias-smoke` (command timeout at least 25 minutes). A nonzero exit is data. Save the last 60 lines of output, secrets stripped, to attempt-1/run-tail.txt.
5. Copy artifacts/e2e-alias-smoke.json and .md (if they exist) into bench/results/stage3-alias/attempt-1/. If no report was written, put the verbatim failure text in attempt-1/run-failure.txt. Never copy a report older than step 3.
6. Write attempt-1/operator-note.md (about 120 words, strictly factual): sha, whether the test passed, the report summary fields (photo_prompts, photo_prompts_rejected, photo_rejections_term_leak, narrations_with_photo_word, elicited, one_b_a_r2_committed, one_b_b_r1_committed, one_b_rejected), bundles_visible, turns_total, and any failure text verbatim. Quote; do not interpret.
